physics_goals.quote: We plan, realize, run and analyze high precision experiments with high energetic real photons at MAMI in the photon-energy range between 40 MeV and 1603 MeV.
physics_goals.value: Improve the understanding of the structure of mesons and nucleons by studying photoproduction of mesons off nucleons with polarisation observables

summary.plain: A2 uses tagged high-energy photons from the Mainz accelerator on proton and deuteron targets, detected by the Crystal Ball and TAPS calorimeters that cover nearly the full sphere, to study how mesons and nucleons are built by watching mesons being produced.
summary.technical: A2 Collaboration at MAMI: tagged photon beam (40 MeV to 1603 MeV) on liquid-hydrogen/deuterium, polarised frozen-spin and nuclear targets, detected with the Crystal Ball (about 4 pi) plus TAPS forward wall and central tracker: meson photoproduction cross sections and polarisation observables, Compton scattering and nucleon polarisabilities.
